zh-CN.label: 高解释置信度
zh-CN.body: 本次作答节奏和一致性支持正常阅读报告。
zh-CN.user_guidance: 可以阅读核心模式、维度摘要和行动建议，但仍应把它们理解为本次自我报告的解释，不是能力排名或外部评价。
zh-CN.retest_note: 如果你想观察变化，建议在 30–90 天后或经历明显生活变化后复测。
zh-CN.why_this_level: 作答速度、连续相同选择、极端/中立选择和一致性线索未显示明显质量风险。
zh-CN.how_to_read: 先看核心洞察和证据快照，再结合现实场景判断哪些描述与近期经验相符。
zh-CN.what_to_trust: 可以较稳定地参考维度间的相对强弱、主要 formulation 和已选场景。
zh-CN.what_to_hold_lightly: 具体分数、百分位和等级仍是阶段性样本下的估计，不应当作精确能力排名、诊断或职业判断。

en.label: High interpretation confidence
en.body: Your response pace and consistency support normal report reading.
en.user_guidance: You can read the core pattern, dimension summary, and action suggestions while keeping them as self-report interpretation, not ability ranking or external evaluation.
en.retest_note: If you want to observe change, retest after 30–90 days or after a meaningful life change.
en.why_this_level: Speed, repeated choices, extreme/neutral responding, and consistency signals did not show a clear response-quality risk.
en.how_to_read: Start with the core insight and evidence snapshot, then compare the selected scenes with your recent experience.
en.what_to_trust: The relative dimension pattern, selected formulation, and selected scenes can be read with normal confidence.
en.what_to_hold_lightly: Specific scores, percentiles, and bands are still estimates within a provisional sample; they are not precise ability rankings, diagnoses, or career judgments.

meta.risk_notes: Quality confidence controls interpretation strength. Keep A/B as self-report interpretation, and keep C/D as retest-first guidance without strong profile, career, relationship, or action conclusions.

zh-CN.label: 正常解释置信度
zh-CN.body: 本次结果整体可读，但部分回答可能受当时状态或理解方式影响。
zh-CN.user_guidance: 适合参考主要方向和较明显的维度差异；不要过度解释细小分数差。
zh-CN.retest_note: 如果你想比较正常结果的变化，建议在 30–90 天后或经历明显生活变化后复测。
zh-CN.why_this_level: 质量线索总体可接受，但仍提示报告应按区间和趋势阅读，而不是按精确分数阅读。
zh-CN.how_to_read: 优先看重复出现的主题：哪个维度更突出、哪个场景更贴近、哪条行动建议最容易低风险尝试。
zh-CN.what_to_trust: 可以参考核心模式、四维摘要和场景提示的主要方向。
zh-CN.what_to_hold_lightly: 百分位、band、轻微维度差异和职业环境提示都应保留弹性解释。

en.label: Standard interpretation confidence
en.body: The result is readable overall, though some answers may reflect your state or interpretation at the time.
en.user_guidance: Use the broad direction and clearer dimension gaps; avoid over-reading small score differences.
en.retest_note: To compare change in a normally interpretable result, retest after 30–90 days or after a meaningful life change.
en.why_this_level: Quality signals are generally acceptable, but the report should still be read as ranges and tendencies rather than precise scores.
en.how_to_read: Look for repeated themes: which dimension stands out, which scene feels closest, and which suggestion is low-risk to try.
en.what_to_trust: You can use the main direction of the core pattern, four-dimension summary, and scene translation.
en.what_to_hold_lightly: Percentiles, bands, small dimension gaps, and career-environment cues should remain flexible interpretations.

meta.risk_notes: Quality confidence controls interpretation strength. Keep A/B as self-report interpretation, and keep C/D as retest-first guidance without strong profile, career, relationship, or action conclusions.

zh-CN.label: 有限解释置信度
zh-CN.body: 本次作答质量只支持谨慎阅读。
zh-CN.user_guidance: 请把结果当作初步线索，优先阅读质量说明和复测建议；不要据此形成强人格、职业或行动结论。
zh-CN.retest_note: 在环境稳定、注意力充足且不受打断时可重新作答，无需等待固定周期；复测后再阅读完整解释。
zh-CN.why_this_level: 作答速度、选择模式或一致性线索提示解释稳定性下降。
zh-CN.how_to_read: 先确认本次作答是否过快、过于集中或受情绪/环境影响；其他内容只作轻量参考。
zh-CN.what_to_trust: 最可靠的信息是：本次作答过程需要复盘，结果不适合直接用作强解释。
zh-CN.what_to_hold_lightly: 核心 formulation、场景、职业环境和行动处方都应轻读，不应用来做重大决定。

en.label: Limited interpretation confidence
en.body: This response quality supports cautious reading only.
en.user_guidance: Treat the result as an initial signal. Read the quality note and retest guidance first; do not turn this session into a strong personality, career, or action conclusion.
en.retest_note: Retake when conditions are steady, your attention is available, and interruptions are unlikely; no fixed waiting period is required. Read the full interpretation after retesting.
en.why_this_level: Speed, response pattern, or consistency signals suggest lower interpretive stability.
en.how_to_read: First ask whether the session was rushed, overly patterned, or affected by mood or environment; use other content only as light reference.
en.what_to_trust: The most reliable message is that the response process needs review and the result should not be used for strong interpretation.
en.what_to_hold_lightly: Core formulation, scenes, career-environment cues, and action prescription should all be held lightly and not used for major decisions.

meta.risk_notes: Quality confidence controls interpretation strength. Keep A/B as self-report interpretation, and keep C/D as retest-first guidance without strong profile, career, relationship, or action conclusions.

zh-CN.label: 低解释置信度
zh-CN.body: 本次作答质量不支持强解释。
zh-CN.user_guidance: 不要用这次结果得出人格结论、职业结论、关系判断或行动处方；它更适合作为复测准备提示。
zh-CN.retest_note: 建议暂时停止阅读深层报告；在环境稳定、注意力充足且不受打断时可重新作答，无需等待固定周期。
zh-CN.why_this_level: 质量线索显示本次结果可能明显受速度、重复模式、极端/中立选择或一致性问题影响。
zh-CN.how_to_read: 只阅读质量说明、科学边界和复测准备；其他模块不应作为当前结论。
zh-CN.what_to_trust: 可以相信的是“本次结果置信度不足”这一提示，而不是具体画像或建议。
zh-CN.what_to_hold_lightly: 分数、百分位、formulation、场景、职业环境和行动建议都不适合在本次作答基础上使用。

en.label: Low interpretation confidence
en.body: This response quality does not support strong interpretation.
en.user_guidance: Do not use this session to draw a personality conclusion, career conclusion, relationship judgment, or action prescription. Treat it mainly as preparation for retaking.
en.retest_note: Pause deeper reading and retake when conditions are steady, your attention is available, and interruptions are unlikely; no fixed waiting period is required.
en.why_this_level: Quality signals suggest the result may have been strongly affected by speed, repeated patterns, extreme/neutral responding, or consistency issues.
en.how_to_read: Read only the quality note, scientific boundary, and retest preparation; other modules should not be treated as current conclusions.
en.what_to_trust: The trustworthy message is that interpretation confidence is too low, not the specific profile or recommendation.
en.what_to_hold_lightly: Scores, percentiles, formulation, scenes, career-environment cues, and action suggestions should not be used from this session.

meta.risk_notes: Quality confidence controls interpretation strength. Keep A/B as self-report interpretation, and keep C/D as retest-first guidance without strong profile, career, relationship, or action conclusions.
